Rooms.Name: The hills
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading north, small hills surrounds you. You feel 
the forces of evil approach you from the north.

Rooms.Name: The hills
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading north. Dark, threatening hills 
surrounds you to almost all sides.

Rooms.Name: Cave entrance
Rooms.Description:
The path stops here. To the north is a single mountain, and around
you are some threatening hills. There may be some way to climb this 
mountain. There is a dark cave to the north. You see a large sign on 
the mountain.

Rooms.Name: The cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a cave. To the south you sense fresh air. To the 
north a small tunnel continues into the mountain.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You force your way through a small tunnel. To you south you 
sense a little fresh air, and to the north the tunnel continues.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small tunnel. To the north there is a cave. The 
tunnel continues to the east.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small tunnel leading east-west. The floor is covered 
with dust.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a tunnel. The tunnel continues to the south and to 
the west, to the north there is a cave.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description: You are in a small tunnel leading  west.

Rooms.Name: The large cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large cave. The cave continues east and west and to 
the south you notice a small tunnel.

Rooms.Name: The large cave
Rooms.Description: You are in the east end of the large cave.

Rooms.Name: The cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the south end of a cave. To the south you see a 
tunnel. You notice a large pile of bones in the corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You better watch out - some of the bones are human!

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description: You are in a north-south leading tunnel.

Rooms.Name: The hole
Rooms.Description: You are by a hole in the floor. You can leave down or north.

Rooms.Name: The hole
Rooms.Description: You are by a hole in the floor. Exits are down or east.

Rooms.Name: The damp tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a damp tunnel and your clothes feel wet. The tunnel 
continues to the north. To the west you see a hole in the floor 
and to the east there is a large cave.

Rooms.Name: The large cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the western part of the large cave. To the west you 
see a damp tunnel.

Rooms.Name: The damp tunnel
Rooms.Description: You are in a damp tunnel, that leads west.

Rooms.Name: The cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the north end of a cave. To the east you see some tunnels 
which lead in many directions.

Rooms.Name: The many tunnels
Rooms.Description: You are in a tunnel that branches off in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a north-south leading tunnel. You also notice a tunnel 
to the west. From the north you sense the fresh air!

Rooms.Name: The smelly tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a north-south leading tunnel. There is a  small 
light coming from the north, along with a strange smell.

Rooms.Name: The cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a cave that is filled with fresh air. You feel the wind 
blowing from the north. To the south you see a small tunnel continuing
into the mountain. A bright opening can be seen to the north.

Rooms.Name: The light cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a light cave. Through a large hole above you, you see the 
sky. A small tunnel to the south is the only way out. You notice the 
source of the strange smell -  all around you there is corpses from 
several monsters.

Rooms.Name: The valley
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small valley surrounded by hills and a mountain to 
the  south. In the mountain there is a cave. To the north you enter 
the hills.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Well it doesn't look nice, but it's the only way out..

Rooms.Name: The foothills
Rooms.Description:
You are on a winding path that leads through the foothills on the 
other side of the mountain. The path continues north.

Rooms.Name: The intersection in the foothills
Rooms.Description:
The small path you are following splits here. The path continues 
north and south or you can follow a trail east into the mountains.

Rooms.Name: The grassy area of the foothills
Rooms.Description:
The grass here is unusually high. You notice several areas where 
someone or something large has crushed spots in the grass. Several 
very large rocks litter this area. You can go north, west or south.

Rooms.Name: The foothills end
Rooms.Description:
At this point you are leaving the foothills. You see a plains area 
to the north of here. You can spot a small city in the distance from 
here.

Rooms.Name: The plains
Rooms.Description: The plains. The only exit is south.

Rooms.Name: The foothills path
Rooms.Description:
You follow a path towards the mountains. To the west you see a path 
making its way north and south through the foothills. To the east 
huge mountains tower above you.

Rooms.Name: Base of the mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the base of the huge mountains of Moria. In 
the distance you can see a small stone building to the north. A 
narrow path leads up the mountains to the east.

Rooms.Name: A narrow path up the mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a narrow path up the mountain. To the northwest 
you can see a small stone building disappearing in the distance. To 
the west the path goes down to the base of the mountain and to the 
east the narrow path continues up the mountain.

Rooms.Name: A turn in the narrow path
Rooms.Description:
Here the path makes a turn to the north. To the west the path goes 
down into the valley and to the north the narrow path continues up the 
mountain. To the east you can see a small opening in the mountain rock.

Exits.Description: A bloody spot at the bottom of the mountains

Rooms.Name: The lion's den
Rooms.Description:
As you move closer to the opening you realize its the den of an 
animal of some kind.

Rooms.Name: The level foothills
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself on a level area of ground in the moria foothills.
West from here the foothills become more rocky and mountainous while 
to the east you can make out a large expanse of tall grass. You almost 
fall into what appears to be a huge footprint - you don't think it would 
be much fun running into anything with such big feet!

Rooms.Name: The cave entrance
Rooms.Description:
You stand before a huge cave entrance, your eyes are unable to pierce 
the darkness, but something around here smells bad. You can enter the 
cave to the west or go back the way you came.

Rooms.Name: The hill giant cave
Rooms.Description:
Ew! This place stinks! A massive hill giant has made this cave his home, 
and his dining habits are totally disgusting, you can see the remains of 
several creatures in a large pot over the fire, and dumped in an unpleasant 
heap in the corner. The cave wall to the north catches your eye.

Exits.Description:
The wall is cracked and you can glimpse another chamber on the other side 
glittering with a thousand colours.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a tunnel which turns here. The tunnel continues to the 
east and the south.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in an east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel is very narrow 
here.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description: You are in an east-west leading tunnel.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description: You are at a turn, the tunnel continues north and east.

Rooms.Name: The light cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a cave. South of you there is a large fire that 
lights the entire cave. To the east and west tunnels leads off.

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description:
You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. Only exit is west to a 
light cave.

Rooms.Name: The light cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in a light cave.  A large fire in front of you lights the 
room. The cave continues to the north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Well, errh - It looks somehow quite warm..!

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description:
You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. Exits leads both north 
and south.

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. Exits leads west and south.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a tunnel. The only exit lies to the east. You sense 
that the tunnel leads slightly down.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small tunnel. To the west the tunnel continues 
and to the east you see some light.

Rooms.Name: The light cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the south end of a light cave. Tunnels lead off to the 
south and west.

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. Exits leads east and west.

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. Exits leads north and east.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a tunnel. The only exit is west, except for a hole in 
the ceiling.

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description:
You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. The tunnel continues east. 
To the north there is a light cave.

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description:
You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. Exits leads east and north. 
To the south is a large cave.

Rooms.Name: The maze
Rooms.Description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels. Exits leads west and north.

Rooms.Name: The large cave
Rooms.Description: You are in the northwest end of a large cave.

Rooms.Name: The large cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the northeast end of a large cave. To the north there 
is a small damp tunnel.

Rooms.Name: The large cave
Rooms.Description: You are in the southwest end of a large cave.

Rooms.Name: The large cave
Rooms.Description:
You are in the southeast end of a large cave. To the east you notice 
a small tunnel.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a narrow tunnel which leads both to the east and the 
south. There is also an exit towards the west, where you see a large 
cave.

Rooms.Name: End of tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel stops here. There are no other exits than the one you 
came from.

Rooms.Name: The hole
Rooms.Description:
You are at a small hole in the floor. You can either leave 
north or try your luck and leave down into the unknown!

Rooms.Name: Mid-air
Rooms.Description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in all of 
ELITEMUD. The result of such a foolish act should be punished with 
death, you know. With an acceleration of approximately 9.82 meters per 
second per second, you are now descending into the Abyss. What 
awaits you at the bottom will continue to be a mystery.

Rooms.Name: Inside the hole
Rooms.Description:
You step down into the hole, and you feel a little bit squished. 
Up seems to be the only way you can go.

Mobs.Name: snake
Mobs.LongDescription: A large dreadful snake is at your feet, hissing at you.

Mobs.Name: snake
Mobs.LongDescription: A small green snake is here, and it doesn't look too friendly...

Mobs.Name: centipede
Mobs.LongDescription: A small centipede is here, making its way across the floor.

Mobs.Name: kobold
Mobs.LongDescription: An ugly kobold is here, searching for dinner.

Mobs.Name: orc
Mobs.LongDescription: The orc walks around, looking for someone to kill.
Mobs.Description: You notice an evil look in his eyes...

Mobs.Name: orc
Mobs.LongDescription: A large orc is here, looking really mean.

Mobs.Name: warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior is here.  He has more scars than anyone you have ever seen.
Mobs.Description: He seems to be a strong, brainless fighter.

Mobs.Name: warrior
Mobs.Description: He seems to know his way with weapons.

Mobs.Name: centipede
Mobs.Description: The centipede doesn't really seem to notice you.

Mobs.Name: orc
Mobs.LongDescription: An orc is here, looking for something (or perhaps someone?) to eat.
Mobs.Description: Well, he doesn't seem to be friendly.

Mobs.Name: lion mountain
Mobs.LongDescription: A mountain lion is here, growling at you viciously.
Mobs.Description: The lion looks very nasty with huge claws and big teeth.

Mobs.Name: giant hill
Mobs.LongDescription: A hill giant is here, tossing some rocks around.
Mobs.Description:
The hill giant looks like he's about 9 feet tall.  By his actions you 
come to the conclusion that he's not very intelligent.

Objects.Name: ring yellow green
Objects.Description: A ring is here, with yellow and green ornamentation.  It looks very old.

Objects.Name: corpse
Objects.Description: A halfway decayed corpse of a goblin is here, giving off a foul odor.

Objects.Name: coins
Objects.Description: A small pile of coins is on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Let's put it this way - I wouldn't eat it!!
